instruction: A candid outdoor full-body photograph captures a couple walking on a sunny day. On the left, the blonde woman in the checkered dress (R2) walks forward, holding a bouquet of red roses in her right hand and looking lovingly at her partner. On the right, the man in the peach t-shirt (R1) walks beside her, returning her gaze with a gentle smile. They walk side-by-side on a paved park path, holding hands. The scene is illuminated by bright, direct midday sunlight casting sharp shadows on the ground, with lush green trees in the background.
